Identifier for the experimental phase or block a trial belongs to (e.g., practice, test, recall).

Milliseconds elapsed, taken from the raw `time` column. In exp1 and exp2 this is cumulative time since the start of the session -- it increases monotonically within a participant -- NOT the latency of an individual response. Per-response latencies would have to be derived by differencing consecutive values. In exp3 the values are not monotonic and do look like per-trial latencies.
The linguistic or visual stimulus presented to the participant in a given trial.
In retest phase, is this stimulus reversed (TRUE), or not (FALSE). NA in test phase.

Unique id of the stimulus pair.

Presentation order within the session (0-indexed). The order in which the participant saw this trial.
